entries.text: Worked on the Little Dart Mk 12 (version 5, 42% built): riveting and shaping Rusty Jr over the VFD display panel on the dash frame to form a glare hood (used Dibs, a strip of hull plating)

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "cockpit glare shield"
Idea: Wire an altimeter sensor directly into an old pressure gauge casing to make a twitchy dashboard dial for the Little Dart.
Read "Arduino: Guide for BMP388 Altimeter (Pressure, Altitude, Temperature) | Random Nerd Tutorials": A tiny pressure chip only needs a couple of I2C data lines to calculate how high you're flying.
digging into pressure sensor schematics on the Wire
entries.why: My dish picked up the idea of a standalone altimeter and now I need the schematic.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "altimeter plans"

Read "Arduino ®": Someone out in the deep signal web built a whole dashboard out of loose controller chips just so they wouldn't forget how it works.

pulling down the NE594N VFD driver datasheet at the tower
